reviewed_invariants: The base must be the committed current generation with matching analysis/revision/source/replay digest; current generation is checked again before yielding.
Parsed original replay identity, counts, strict source frames, exact states, input fingerprints, typed round-trip, duplicate identities, and source ordering are checked before acceptance.
Semantic amendments preserve source measurements, event identity and interval clocks; physical and reviewed signal contracts cannot be silently interchanged; unchanged commands are refused.
Actual line calls are recomputed in the rebuilt rule context from sealed observations and current event geometry; original recorded decisions are not reusable evaluators.
The source adapter validates sealed frame joins, keeps duration-dependent arrays in owned disk storage, withholds missing/static-unregistered geometry, and masks unsuitable neighbours.
Pending timeline/journal/source owners close on success and downstream failure; this core neither publishes artifacts nor changes the committed base.
Unchanged-only reproduction retains its transition, rule interpretation, raw final-state, shot/timeline/membership verification contract.
authorship_disclosure: This reviewer authored the shared source extraction and primitive repair. The corrected builder and source adapter were authored by other agents; a separate test author supplied the 41-case corrected-core regressions. This artifact is not a claim of independent authorship review of the decoder itself.
excluded_and_still_required: Shot rebuilding/relinking, corrected analytics and forecasts, fresh annotated rendering, complete generation publication, correction API/authenticated queue/UI, and end-to-end report/media revision consistency.
Actual model inference, independent physical or score accuracy qualification, actual full-match duration/crash-resume acceptance, and sustained live video acceptance.
